item.title: Mark Zuckerberg Blasts Centralization of A.I. Power
item.description: In an interview with The Times, Meta’s chief executive took aim at Anthropic and OpenAI, which have pushed to tightly control A.I. development, and said he supported “more openness.”
item.dc:creator: Mike Isaac and Eli Tan
item.media:credit: Jason Henry for The New York Times
item.media:description: Mark Zuckerberg, Meta’s chief executive, said there needed to be people “bringing realism” to a debate about the way forward on artificial intelligence development.

item.title: As Trump Squeezes Cuba, He Plans to Send Cuban Deportees to Uruguay
item.description: The State Department under Secretary of State Marco Rubio has deported Cubans to Africa. Now it’s negotiating with a South American country.

item.title: Summer of Heat, Fires and Storms Is a Reckoning for Europe on Climate

item.dc:creator: Mark Landler and Chico Harlan
item.media:credit: Pablo Blazquez Dominguez/Getty Images
item.media:description: Firefighters using controlled burns to stop the spread of wildfires near Madrid on Tuesday.

item.title: Wildfires Slow in France and Spain, but Worse May Be Ahead
item.description: Firefighters have contained vast wildfires in both countries, but winds are high and temperatures rising. Spain’s prime minister said the next 12 hours would be “decisive.”
item.dc:creator: Carlos Barragán, Ségolène Le Stradic and Roser Toll Pifarré
item.media:credit: Emma Da Silva/Associated Press
item.media:description: A firefighter resting near Lanton, France, on Tuesday.
